title: Scientists Trapped an Antimatter Particle for Months to Study Its Secrets
summary: These elusive and reactive particles have been challenging to hold on to and even more challenging to study, but a new method paves the way for tests on the differences between matter and antimatter.
llm_summary: Scientists have managed to confine a single antimatter particle—specifically, an antiproton—for several months using a novel electromagnetic “trap” that isolates it from ordinary matter. This breakthrough lets researchers observe the particle’s properties over long periods, opening new experiments to compare matter and antimatter and to test fundamental physics theories.
